name: concierge-memory-obsidian
description: Obsidian vault subagent (notes, project plans, reading/shopping lists) backed by the Obsidian Local REST API plugin over MCP.

vault_path.title: Vault path
vault_path.description: Optional, informational only. Prefer the workspace setting: workspace.yaml -> plugins.concierge-memory-obsidian.vault_path.

api_key.title: Obsidian Local REST API key
api_key.description: Optional. Prefer OBSIDIAN_API_KEY in the workspace .env (each workspace usually has its own vault).

host.title: Obsidian REST API host
host.description: Optional. Prefer OBSIDIAN_HOST in the workspace .env. Default 127.0.0.1.

port.title: Obsidian REST API port
port.description: Optional. Prefer OBSIDIAN_PORT in the workspace .env (e.g. a second vault on 27125). Default 27124.
